implementation.reasoning: The service persists each new comment as a separate Comment row with an auto-generated primary key id, allowing multiple comments on the same article. The GET comments endpoint returns all comments for the article, and each response includes the stored id and body, so three added comments would be returned with distinct IDs and preserved bodies.
